claims.text: A linked source is public, internal or client-confidential.
A client-confidential source may be read only by the Claude Code command line tool or by a local model.
A hosted model receives client-confidential text only when consent is recorded for the source.
A claim takes the highest sensitivity of its sources.
Transcripts and memory files default to client-confidential.
A chunk holds at most 4,096 estimated tokens.
The token estimate is the number of characters divided by four, rounded up.
The chunk budget cannot be set below 500 tokens.
A line is never split, and a line longer than the budget forms its own chunk.
The extractor of a later chunk receives a digest of what the earlier chunks produced.
Three extractors share three permits with all other background model work.
The audit and the merge run one at a time in first in first out order.
The auditor must see the graph after every earlier merge, or two audits could add copies of one proposition.
The auditor never sees the source text and returns identity links only.
A message fingerprint is the SHA-256 hash of its role and its text.
A message is covered when its fingerprint is in the coverage file of the source.
Editing a message makes only that message uncovered again.
Coverage lines are written last in a merge, so a run that stops early leaves its batch uncovered.
